facts.fact: Senegal and the Gambia signed an MoU on cooperation in telecommunications, ICT and the digital economy in Dakar on 12 June 2026, during the Senegalo-Gambian Presidential Council.
facts.system: Senegal-Gambia MoU on telecommunications, ICT and the digital economy

facts.fact: The first Steering Committee Meeting under the Senegal-Gambia MoU was held in Banjul to set an implementation roadmap; the meeting day is not given, so the published date month is used.
